product_metadata.title: Solpex Tabletop Christmas Tree, 24 Inch Artificial Christmas Tree Battery Operated Lighted Mini Christmas Tree with LED Light for Christmas Decorations, Home Décor, Kitchen, Dining Table
features: 【Realistic Appearance】 Prelit tabletop mini Christmas tree is the best choice for Christmas decoration. Made of durable and realistic plastic needles, the Christmas tree looks more realistic and has long-lasting durability.

【DIY Tree Ornaments】Small Christmas tree with lights includes a golden star treetop, 12 Christmas gold balls, 12 gold bells, 30 red berries, and a 4-meter LED string light, which can be hung on the Christmas trees as you wish.

【LED String Light】The tabletop Christmas tree is decorated with 25 LED string lights, powered by 2 AA batteries (not included), you can place the Christmas tree wherever you want to brighten your Christmas night for your family.

【Ideal Christmas Decoration】Beautifully decorated, this Christmas tabletop tree is the perfect addition to your holiday decoration. Our artificial Christmas tree is a perfect gift for your friends and family, and will add more festive atmosphere to your home.

【Application】Suitable for decorating houses, offices and even kitchens to give you a wonderful festive memory. The mini Christmas tree can be placed on the window sill, desk, mantel, countertop and any place you want to decorate.
